correctness.rationale: For all integers k>=2,N>=2k, the Plucker metric from log det(I+Z*Z) has Ricci form 2N omega0 by the Kronecker determinant; g=2N*g0 obeys Ric(g)=g. The canonical intrinsic Grassmann geodesic metric is the l2 norm of principal angles; N>=2k permits k orthogonal principal pairs, giving diam(g0)=pi sqrt(k)/2 and scaled diam=pi sqrt(Nk/2). With m=k(N-k), pi^2*m-diam^2=pi^2*k*(N-2k)/2. At N=2k this vanishes, but b2(Gr_C(k,2k))=1 and b2((CP1)^(k^2))=k^2, excluding even a homeomorphism for k>=2. The normalized CP1 k=1 edge check matches diameter pi/2 before Einstein scaling. Actual seven source files and Git SHA were inspected; exact rational chart and general polynomial gap recomputed independently. The ambient Plucker projective distance is not used. This only disproves uniqueness of equality, not the inequality.
